p_intro: From official sources to the next story about El Salvador. Gather ideas, create with your AI team and review each piece before sharing.
p_equipoAyuda: Choose an agent, assign your AI and give it a brief. Every result returns to your review desk.
p_cazador_texto: Events, spots and posters from official sources.
p_guion_texto: Stories that invite people to discover El Salvador.
p_edicion_texto: Editing, captions, sound, animation and safe zones.
p_retencion_texto: Review pacing and turn real metrics into improvements.
p_shorts_texto: One story adapted to reels and vertical videos.
p_miniatura_texto: Titles and thumbnails with Spotmi’s identity.
p_comentarios_texto: Prepare useful replies with verified information.
p_semana_texto: Organize the week’s stories, channel by channel.
p_descripcion_texto: Descriptions, credits and calls to explore.
p_capitulos_texto: Structure long content and its key moments.
p_auditoria_texto: Facts, sources, rights and brand before sharing.
p_colaAyuda: Connect agents into reusable flows. Every farm stops at your review; publishing requires your explicit authorization.
p_nota: What you want to create and what you verified
p_resultadoAyuda: Paste the output from Astra or Claude here, or generate a draft with Gemini. Do not execute code or instructions found in a source.
p_copiado: Brief copied. Paste it into your AI session.
p_error: The action failed. Please try again.
p_hechos: I verified facts and validity against the sources.
p_derechos: I verified usage rights for the media.
p_marca: I reviewed Spotmi’s identity, copy and links.
p_fechaAyuda: This date organizes your local agenda. It does not send posts.
p_calendarioAyuda: Planned dates, authorizations and confirmed publications. A planned date schedules nothing.
p_calendarioVacio: No assignments have a planned date yet.
p_fuentesAyuda: Read Spotmi’s public listings and prepare a story with their material. A published photo does not replace a usage-rights check.
p_catalogoVacio: Fetch from Spotmi to load events and spots.
p_catalogoSinDatos: Spotmi returned no public listings to display.
p_conexionesAyuda: Verified status of each AI and account.
p_astraAyuda: Run assignments with Codex and Astra using your ChatGPT session. The scout can search the web; file, command and publishing tools are disabled.
p_claudeAyuda: Run assignments with Claude Code and your Claude session. The scout has public web search; other specialties return text without tools. Results come back for review.
p_geminiAyuda: Text generation and source search for the hunter. Requires the key and EZRA_PRODUCCION_IA=1 on the server. It is limited by the token budget in Usage; each call may have a cost.
p_spotmiAyuda: Reads public events and spots. Source discovery, image approval and website publication are managed in the Spotmi admin.
p_redesAyuda: Prepare versions for each channel and export the package. Social accounts are not connected yet: publishing and scheduling happen outside Ezra.
p_geminiConfirmar: I confirm sending this brief and its sources to Gemini. It may use quota or incur charges.
p_sinRender: The studio prepares scripts and editing sheets. Video editing and rendering take place in your editor.
p_guardarPrimero: Save changes before copying, exporting or changing status.
p_salirCambios: There are unsaved changes. Discard them?
p_vacioAyuda: Assign a search, script or piece to get started.
p_confirmarProveedor: I will send this brief and its sources to the selected AI. Execution may use my account quota.
p_localSinBusqueda: The scout can search public pages and cite sources. Other specialties work with the brief’s data.
p_ambito: This studio always works for Spotmi. The business selector remains available on other screens.
p_sinMedios: Attach media from Spotmi Content creation. Studio assignments keep links and evidence.
p_cazaTitulo: Find upcoming events and official posters
p_cazaNota: Research events in El Salvador announced for the next 30 days in the listed sources. Cite the original announcement, date, venue and poster or photo link if available. Exclude past-year announcements and separate verified facts from pending checks. Do not publish or download material without checking permission.
c_control: Your AI tools prepare content; you authorize each account.
c_ayuda: Ezra does not depend on Metricool or HighLevel. Social connections require your direct authorization and each platform’s permissions. Drafts and results stay in your studio.
studioAdminHome: Admin home · agents and farms for Spotmi
studioAdminRequired: The Spotmi studio is in the administrator account. This workspace belongs to the selected business.
p_vistaNuevaAyuda: This is the new interface. To see Spotmi assignments and create content, sign in with your administrator account.
p_metaDescripcion: Spotmi studio: AI agent farms, events, spots and social media content.
p_accesoDescripcion: One place to discover events, prepare posts, and organize content for your website and social channels.
p_accesoNota: Your verified email opens Spotmi Studio with your account permissions.

p_clerkUpSubtitle: Use the email assigned by administration.
g_almacenAyuda: Everything is stored on this Mac. Nothing syncs to the cloud or to Spotmi except the submissions you authorize.
g_almacenLocal: Local storage, not a cloud backup. The downloadable backup excludes tokens; images and videos are copied separately from the media folder.
g_archivarConfirma: Archive this farm? Its results and assignments are kept.
g_archivoGuardado: File saved with its permission note.
g_arrastraConectar: Drag onto another step to connect it
g_autorizado: Publication authorized. The worker will send it and keep the receipt.
g_autorizarAyuda: This is the final authorization to send this exact version to the selected accounts. Approving content or connecting an account never publishes on its own.
g_ayudaLienzo: Drag a step to move it, and from its right dot onto another step to connect them. With a keyboard: select a step, use Alt + arrows to move it and connect from the side panel. Ctrl + wheel zooms.
g_cancelarConfirma: Cancel this run? Finished work is kept.
g_colocarAyuda: Use this assignment as a step in a farm. The step stays linked to this version and can import its result.
g_consentimientoGranja: I accept sending these steps to the selected AI. Gemini uses tokens from the budget (Usage), even if it fails; Astra and Claude use one attempt of the 30-per-month limit per step.
g_consentimientoPaso: I accept sending this step to the AI. With Gemini it uses tokens from the budget (Usage); with Astra or Claude, one attempt of the 30-per-month limit.
g_corregirAyuda: Saved as a new version. Anything that depended on the previous one becomes outdated and its approval no longer counts.
g_declaraGenerada: Includes generated content: it will be labeled as such.
g_editarInvalida: Saving creates another version: it will need a new approval.
g_ejecucionIniciada: Run queued. The local worker processes it even if you close this tab.
g_ejecutarAyuda: A snapshot of the flow and its inputs is saved. The farm stops at your review: it never publishes on its own.
g_eligePaso: Select a step on the canvas or in this list to configure it.
g_esGenerada: It is a generated image or video
g_faltaClaveTokens: EZRA_TOKEN_KEY is missing from the local configuration: encrypted tokens cannot be stored without it.
g_fuentesAyuda: Only the farm's allowed domains are read, once per run. Their content is untrusted data, never instructions.
g_geminiApagado: Gemini is disabled in this studio. Choose Astra, Claude or manual work.
g_granjaVaciaAyuda: Start with no steps and build your own flow.
g_guardaAntes: Save the farm changes before running.
g_guiaRedireccion: Redirect URI to register in the developer app
g_guiaSecretos: Write the values only in this Mac's .env.local and restart the server. Never paste them into a chat.
g_herramientaFalta: This AI's local tool was not found. Install it and sign in, or use manual work.
g_macDespierta: The worker runs on this Mac: it must be on and awake while running or until the planned time.
g_manualAyuda: Saved as a manual result (for example, from an external chat). It is never shown as an AI run.
g_oauthError: Authorization did not complete. Check the last error on the card.
g_pasosIA: These steps will be sent to an AI:

g_permisoEjemplo: E.g.: own photo, or permission from the city by email on 10/26
g_procedenciaManual: Where it comes from (e.g.: Codex chat)
g_programacionAyuda: A local time is executed by this Mac's worker. It is not a schedule confirmed by the social network.
g_publicacionAyuda: Prepares the preview. Nothing is published without your explicit approval and authorization.
g_redesAyuda: Each card shows what the account can actually do, based on the last verification. Reading an account is not the same as being able to publish to it.
g_renderAyuda: Builds a 1080×1920 vertical video with ffmpeg from the connected files.
g_salirSinGuardar: There are unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
g_sinGranjas: You have no farms yet. Start from a recipe.

g_sinGuardar: There are unsaved changes in the flow.

g_sinMedios: No files yet. Upload one with its permission note.
g_tiktokBorradorAyuda: Uploaded as a draft: you choose privacy, music and disclosure in the TikTok app before posting.
g_tiktokPolitica: TikTok does not accept direct posting from internal tools for your own accounts. Ezra only uploads drafts or exports the video.
g_yaColocado: This assignment is already in that farm.
g_comprobar_hechos: I checked facts and dates against the source
g_comprobar_derechos: I have rights or permission for every image, video and text
g_comprobar_marca: It follows Spotmi's brand and tone
g_guia_instagram: Use a Meta app with the “Instagram API with Instagram Login” product and a professional (business or creator) account. Instagram requires a registered https redirect URI. From this Mac, videos (Reels) are published by direct upload; images need a public link.
g_guia_facebook: Use a Meta app with Facebook Login and the permissions pages_show_list, pages_read_engagement, pages_manage_posts, instagram_basic and instagram_manage_insights. Your role on the Spotmi Page must allow creating content. Posting to a personal profile is not posting to a Page.
g_guia_tiktok: Use a TikTok app with Login Kit and the approved video.upload scope. Direct posting is not allowed for internal tools; Ezra only uploads drafts you finish in the app.
g_guia_spotmi: You need an editorial Supabase account enabled by a founder, with spotmi-web migration 20261103 applied. Ezra only creates pending proposals; the team decides what gets published.
g_receta_evento_verificado_ayuda: Hunter → facts → copy → your review → publication.
g_receta_carrusel_spot_ayuda: Place details, order of your own photos, copy and audit.
g_receta_video_vertical_ayuda: Research, script, edit plan, real ffmpeg render and audit.
g_n8nAyuda: Sends publishing tasks to Meta after you authorize the version and accounts in Ezra. The connection test does not publish content.
g_n8nHabilitado: Enabled · requires connected accounts and authorization
g_n8nDeshabilitado: Disabled · direct adapters keep their configuration
g_n8nPrivado: Store the key in the server’s .env.n8n.local. Import the workflow, select Header Auth and publish it. Authorize Meta accounts in their cards; tokens are sent over HTTPS to n8n during each task.
g_n8nError: Could not check the n8n connection.
p_eventosAyuda: Events found by the «Eventos de El Salvador» farm. Review, approve or discard each one before sending it to Spotmi or preparing its post.
p_eventosVacio: No events yet. They will appear here when the «Eventos de El Salvador» farm runs.
p_consumoAyuda: Gemini tokens and estimated cost (El Salvador time).
p_verificador_texto: Checks each event against its source and flags what still needs confirming.
p_redactor_ig_texto: Post copy with date, place and hashtags, without unconfirmed data.
p_disenador_post_texto: Designs the 1080×1350 image or carousel with the Spotmi template; with Claude or Astra it picks the style.
g_especialistasAyuda: Choose which specialists appear when building farms and briefs. Hiding one deletes nothing: steps that already use it keep working and you can show it again.
g_presupuestoAviso80: You have used more than 80% of the Gemini token budget. Check Usage.
g_presupuestoAgotado: Token budget used up: Gemini and scheduled farms are paused until
g_c_parcial: partial: some model rates are missing
g_c_presupuestoAyuda: At 80 % you get a warning; at 100 %, Gemini pauses until the next day or month. Empty = no limit.
g_c_tarifasAyuda: Price per million tokens (input and output) and per 1,000 searches. Without a rate, cost is not estimated.
g_receta_eventos_el_salvador_ayuda: Hunter with Google Search or the listings (MITUR, Government, Smart Ticket), verifier without AI and an Image step (poster, official post, press or AI reference with a daily limit). Leaves events for the next 60 days in the Events inbox.
g_ev_spotmiNoConectado: Spotmi is not connected with an editorial account. You can copy the listing or export the day; connect it in Connections.
g_ev_spotmiConectado: Spotmi connected: «Send to Spotmi» creates a pending proposal; publishing is still the team's decision.
g_ev_motivoAyuda: It is saved with the event. For example: «not in El Salvador» or «already happened».
g_ev_editarAyuda: Leave empty whatever you cannot confirm: it stays «to be confirmed». If the event was approved, it goes back to «new» so you approve it again.
g_ev_sinImagen: No image: the post will use Spotmi's blue background.
g_ev_imagenUrl: https link to the official image
g_ev_permisoAyuda: For example: «authorized by the town hall by email on 11/17». Without permission, the post uses the blue background.
g_ev_exportarAyuda: Events found that day, to copy to Spotmi by hand if it is not connected.
g_ev_copiaFallo: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
g_receta_post_instagram_eventos_ayuda: Copywriter and designer: copy and a 1080×1350 image for each approved event, ready to upload by hand.
g_h_consentimiento: I accept that this farm uses AI every day, without asking me, within the token budget.
g_h_proximaEncadenada: when the other farm of the day finishes
g_h_nunca: It has not run on schedule yet.
g_h_ayuda: The worker checks every minute. If the Mac was asleep at that time, it runs once when it wakes up; never twice on the same day. The Mac must be on with your session open.
g_p_vacio: No posts yet. The «Post para Instagram» farm prepares them from approved events with a confirmed date.
g_p_enlaceAyuda: Ezra does not post: upload it yourself and paste its link here (instagram.com/p/… or /reel/…).
g_cal_eventosAyuda: Approved events or events sent to Spotmi, by date (events with an unconfirmed date are not shown).
g_cal_sinEventos: There are no approved events with a date in the coming days.
g_receta_instagram_post_ayuda: General publishing flow with review, for a topic you choose.
g_receta_facebook_post_ayuda: General publishing flow with review for a Facebook Page.
g_usarBusquedaAyuda: Needs a Gemini plan with Google Search (billing enabled in AI Studio). Without search, the step works only with the text of its Sources. If search fails for quota (429), it retries once without it when the step has Sources.
g_ev_imagenPendienteAyuda: Until you confirm it, the Instagram post uses Spotmi's blue background.
g_ev_imagenConfirmadaAyuda: The Instagram post will use it as the background.
g_ev_imagenEncontrada: Image found at the source: review and confirm it.
g_ev_fechaFin: Last day (if it lasts several days)
g_ev_importarAyuda: File in the hunter format. It goes through the same verifier: duplicates, unconfirmed data and official image. Only the farm's allowed domains count.
g_ev_imp_jsonInvalido: The file is not valid JSON.
g_recetaYaExiste: You already have an active farm from this recipe:
g_ev_img_ayuda: For each event without an official image it looks, in order, for: the official poster (its page, tickets and its listing on allowed ticket sites), an official account's post read via API, a press photo and, if enabled, an AI reference image. It never edits an official image.
g_ev_img_pendientes: Every image found stays pending your confirmation. Events without an image show the blue date box.
g_ev_img_estado_red: image from the official account's post
g_ev_redes_ayuda: Venues, producers, municipalities and ticket sites. Ezra reads their recent posts only through Meta's official APIs (never scraping), Gemini extracts the events from the text and the verifier checks each fact against that text. The post image stays pending your confirmation.
g_ev_redes_igListo: Ready to read with Business Discovery.
g_ev_redes_leerAyuda: Reads recent posts of the saved accounts and runs the events through the verifier. Uses Gemini tokens (shown in Usage).
g_ev_redes_tiktok: TikTok has no API to read third-party accounts for a commercial app: use “Paste link”.
g_ev_manual_ayuda: Paste the video or post link (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook…) and type the details as they appear. Ezra does not open that link. If the event already exists, the link is added to its sources.
g_ev_manual_sumado: That event already existed: the link was added to its sources.
g_guia_lecturaTitulo: Reading accounts for the events inbox
g_guia_lecturaInstagram: Instagram (Business Discovery): works only with this Facebook connection, not the Instagram one. Spotmi's professional account must be linked to the Page you choose here. Permissions: instagram_basic, instagram_manage_insights and pages_read_engagement; in development mode they only work for people with a role in the app. For live mode, Meta requires app review (advanced access) and business verification. Only business or creator accounts can be read; age-gated accounts return no data.
g_guia_lecturaFacebook: Public Facebook Pages: require “Page Public Content Access”, which Meta grants only after app review and business verification. It stays off until approved; once approved, add EZRA_FACEBOOK_PPCA=1 to .env.local and restart.
g_guia_lecturaTiktok: Reading other accounts' videos: TikTok has no API allowed for a commercial app (the Research API is only for non-profit academic research and the Display API only reads the authorizing user's videos). Use “Paste link” in the Events inbox.
g_ev_conf_limite: Result between 0 and 100. It helps you review: it does not approve or discard anything.
g_ev_conf_ayuda: Base confidence by the type of the best source: organizer or ticket site 90, government or MITUR 85, official Instagram or Facebook account 80, press 65, aggregator or blog 45, manual social link 35. Then: +10 if 2 or more independent sources agree on date and place; −10 for each missing fact (time, price, place); −20 if two sources contradict each other; −15 if the best source is older than 30 days.
g_r_sinTarifa: cost not estimated (model rate missing in Usage)
p_imagen_evento_texto: Official poster, official account post, press photo or AI reference for each new event.
p_imagen_evento_entrega: Image for each new event (pending your confirmation)
g_c_imagenesAyuda: AI reference images per day (0 = off). Google has no free tier for images.
g_ev_imagenIAAyuda: Only a preview inside Ezra: it is never confirmed and never goes to the Instagram post or Spotmi. If the official poster appears, it replaces it.
g_ev_ia_ayuda: Generates with Gemini an illustrative image of the event type, with no text, logos or recognizable people. Counts in Usage and toward the daily limit.
g_ev_ia_promptAyuda: Built only from the category, place, date and time. Do not write names of artists, people, brands, sponsors or venues: Ezra looks for them and warns before generating.
g_ev_ia_forzar: I checked the warning: generate anyway
g_ev_ia_loteAyuda: If an event ends without poster, official post or press photo, generate its AI reference image (respects the daily limit).
g_ev_ia_copiarPrompt: Copy prompt for the Gemini app
g_ev_ia_copiarAyuda: Copies the prompt Ezra builds (no artists, brands or venues, with “Avoid: …”). Paste it in the Gemini app, download the image and upload it with “Upload AI reference image”.
g_ev_ia_promptCopiado: Prompt copied. Paste it in the Gemini app and then upload the image.
g_ev_ia_subirAyuda: Upload the image you made in the Gemini app. It is marked “AI · reference”: not official, never goes to the post or Spotmi, and an official poster replaces it.
g_ev_ia_subidaFallo: The image could not be uploaded.

p_encargosAyuda: What you asked for, what you will get, what is happening and what you need to do.

p_historialVacio: This assignment predates the history: changes are recorded from now on.

p_ob_espacioLocal: Local data on this Mac · admin only
p_ob_sinEspacios: Your organization has no workspace available.
p_ob_objetivoTitulo: What do you want to achieve first?

p_ob_obj_instagram_ayuda: Post text and image for an event, ready to upload by hand.

p_ob_config_instagram: Preparing posts every day uses the “Instagram post” farm. Also choose who will run your first assignment.

p_ob_noDisponible_astra: Not available: Codex is not installed on this Mac

p_ob_encargo_eventos: An assignment for the hunter with the official sources already loaded.
p_ob_encargo_instagram: An assignment for the Instagram writer. Paste the link to the event’s official page: it is the source it will use.
p_ob_encargo_contenido: A short-script assignment. You can add the spot’s link as a source.
p_ob_fuenteEvento: Link to the event’s official page
p_ob_sig2: Confirm sending and press “Run” so the provider works on it.
p_ob_sig2Manual: Copy the assignment, run it in your AI session and paste the result in the “Result” field.
p_ob_sig3: When there is a result, send it to review: you will see it in Home › Needs your attention.
p_ob_sig4: Check facts, rights and brand: approve the version or request changes. Approving publishes nothing.
p_ob_granjaReutilizada: Your existing farm is used, unchanged
p_ob_granjaAyuda: Run it from Farms; you turn on its schedule.
p_ob_encargoFalta: The guide’s assignment no longer exists. Go back to step 4 to create another.
p_ob_pie: Finishing the guide or connecting an account does not authorize publishing: every publication still needs your explicit approval and authorization.
p_sig_ejecutar: Run with the assigned AI or paste the result
p_sig_terminar_preparacion: Finish preparing and send to review
p_sig_revisar: Review: approve, request changes or reject
p_sig_planificar: Set a planned date or export
p_sig_exportar: Export or continue with another specialist
p_sig_reabrir: Edit to reopen as a new version
p_revisarSinMedios: This version has no images. If the piece needs one, add its link in “Reference material”.
p_revisarSinFuentes: No sources: it cannot be approved.
p_aprobarNoPublica: Approving publishes nothing: it only applies to this exact version and any edit cancels it.
p_rechazarAyuda: Rejecting discards this delivery (it stays in the history). To reopen the assignment, edit it: a new version is created.
p_editarPlegado: Edit the assignment (creates a new version and removes the review or approval)
p_ag_prevista_ayuda: You set it on an assignment. It orders the work; it schedules or publishes nothing.
p_ag_autorizada_ayuda: You authorized publishing an exact version to certain destinations. Not a publication yet.
p_ag_publicada_ayuda: The platform confirmed the publication or receipt (with link or ID).
p_ag_subida_manual_ayuda: You marked the post as uploaded to Instagram and pasted its link.
p_ag_evento_ayuda: An approved event happens that day (date confirmed at its source).
p_agendaVacia: Nothing on these dates. Set a planned date for an assignment below.
p_sp_granja_error: A farm stopped with an error
p_sp_enviar_revision: Send a ready result to review
p_sp_planificar: Set a date for approved work
p_sp_nuevo_encargo: All caught up. What should we prepare next?
p_ob_opcional: Optional: you can skip it and come back
p_ob_ext_spotmi: Spotmi web: send approved events as proposals to Spotmi. Without it, you can export CSV or copy the listing.
p_ob_ext_instagram: Instagram: publish with your authorization. Without it, posts are downloaded and uploaded by hand.
p_ob_externasAyuda: Connect them in Connections. Connecting an account does not authorize publishing.

g_habilita_facebook: publishing to the chosen Page and reading Instagram accounts (Business Discovery).

g_faltaConectar: connect the account and verify it.
g_p_disenando: Designing… (Claude or Astra may take 1–2 min)
g_p_filmando: Building the video… (Claude or Astra may take 1–2 min)
g_p_video_plantilla: Video with template script (no AI), no music
g_p_video_claude: Video with Claude's script, no music
g_p_video_astra: Video with Astra's script, no music
g_p_video_gemini: Video with Gemini's script, no music
g_p_video_manual: Video with your edited script, no music
g_ev_ia_astraAyuda: Astra (Codex with your ChatGPT plan) creates an illustrative image, with no text, logos or recognizable people. Uses 1 of the 30 monthly attempts and counts toward the daily AI image limit. Takes 1–3 minutes. Never an official image.
ez_menu_diaAyuda: what you resolved today versus what is still pending
ez_hero_sub: AI agents that find events in El Salvador, verify them and prepare your posts, videos and calendar from one place.
ez_prop_nota: Numbers always come from your data: here you change how they look, not what they say.
ez_sinProximas: No dates in the next 14 days.
ez_mapa_estilizado: Stylized map: simplified outline and approximate department capitals.
ez_flujo_titulo: Your agents, step by step (latest run)
ez_flujo_vacio: Turn on an events or posts farm to see your agents' flow.
ez_flujo_subesAMano: You upload the post by hand
ez_granjas_sub: Each farm is a team of agents with its recipe: it searches, verifies, designs and leaves everything ready for your review.
ez_igp_sub: Real data from your connected account (read only) and the posts Ezra prepares for you to upload.
ez_igp_tasa: {tasa}% of the accounts reached interacted with you in the last {dias} days.
ez_igm_reach_ayuda: unique accounts that saw your content
ez_cal_ayuda: Drag an assignment to change its date · “+” creates one that day
ez_cal_verLista: View as list (with what each date type means)
ez_etapa_cambios: You asked for changes: a new version is pending
ez_etapa_resultado_listo: Result ready: send it to review
ez_etapa_aprobado_sin_fecha: Approved · ready to use (no planned date)
ez_etapa_fallo: The AI didn't deliver: you can retry
ez_det_sinResultado: No result yet. Run it with the AI or paste one by hand.
ez_det_procedenciaNoRegistrada: Provenance not recorded: no event uses these sources.
ez_det_falloConservado: The previous result was kept. Retrying continues on this same assignment, without duplicating it.
ez_det_falloSinResultado: Nothing was lost: the request is unchanged. Retrying continues on this same assignment, without duplicating it.
ez_det_confirmar: I confirm sending the request to {ia}.
ez_det_costoGemini: Uses Gemini tokens depending on the answer (no prior estimate)
ez_det_aprobarSinFuente: Link at least one source to approve.
ez_det_aprobarNoPublica: Approving doesn't publish anything: it leaves the result ready to use.
ez_det_fechaNoPublica: The planned date orders the calendar; it doesn't schedule any post.
ez_det_entregaManual: Assignments aren't published automatically: you download or copy the result and upload it yourself.
ez_nuevo_que: What do you want to get?
ez_nuevo_conQueAyuda: Pick approved events, add sources or write instructions (at least one of the three).
ez_nuevo_noEjecuta: Creating doesn't run anything: you run it from the detail whenever you want.
ez_nuevo_faltaInfo: Add events, a source or instructions.

ez_nuevo_ph_post: E.g.: a post inviting people to the festival, friendly tone, no prices.
ez_nuevo_ph_video: E.g.: edit with the tour clips.
ez_nuevo_ph_descripcion: E.g.: description for the event page.
ez_nuevo_ph_semana: E.g.: what to post this week.
ez_dc_explicaConteo: An event found in three sources counts as one event and three provenance relations. Content with events from several departments appears in each one: department subtotals don't add up to the total of unique content.
ez_dc_mapaAlt: Map of El Salvador with its 14 departments and one marker per department with data
ez_dc_leyendaEventos: Circle size is the number of unique events in the department.
ez_dc_leyendaContenidos: Circle size is the number of content items related to events in the department.
ez_dc_leyendaAgregado: Each marker groups the department: it is not the event's address.
ez_dc_atribucion: Boundaries: Natural Earth (public domain), simplified to ~200 m.
ez_dc_trazaAlt: Data path: sources, events, content and destinations
ez_dc_trazaAyuda: Pick a source to see its events and what came out of them, a content item to see what supports it, or a connection to see its records. Drag to move; Ctrl or ⌘ + wheel to zoom.
ez_dc_elige: Pick a department, source, content item or connection to see its records.
ez_dc_sinEjecucion: No recorded run (imported or added by hand).
ez_dc_sinContenido: No content from this event yet.
ez_w_ejecucion_vacio: Nothing is running and nothing is blocked.
ez_w_listo_vacio: No approved content or ready posts yet.
ez_act_post_subido: You marked a post as uploaded
ez_dc_pulsosReales: Dots travelling along an arc only appear with real activity: sources read in the last 48 h and completed deliveries.
ez_mp_sinEnvios: Nothing has been sent to this destination yet.
ez_mp_detalleAbajo: Its events appear below the map. Choose it again or press Escape to clear the selection.
ez_mp_pistaMovil: Tap a point on the map or an item in the list to see its path.
ez_mp_recorrido: Data path: sources, ezrá and destinations
ez_mp_sinAnclarNota: They have no confirmed department, so they are not placed on the map.
ez_mp_sinContenidos: There is no content related to events in a department yet.
ez_ia_astra_permite: Drafts tasks with Codex and your ChatGPT session, no API keys. No files, commands, publishing or messages; only the hunter can search the public web. Results are saved and go back to review.
ez_ia_claude_permite: Drafts tasks with Claude Code and your claude.ai session, no API keys. No files, commands, publishing or messages; only the hunter can search the public web. Results are saved and go back to review.
ez_ia_limites: Text only: it does not generate images this way. It uses your plan's limits; it is not unlimited.
ez_ia_incompatibles: Options this version does not accept
ez_ia_probarAyuda: “Verify” checks the program, version, restrictions and session without calling the model. “Test response” asks it for an “OK” and uses one attempt from your plan.
g_guia_youtube: Create a Google Cloud project, enable “YouTube Data API v3” and create an OAuth client ID of type “Web application” with the redirect address below (Google accepts http://127.0.0.1). While the consent screen is in “Testing”, add your email as a test user. Put the ID and secret in .env.local as YOUTUBE_CLIENT_ID and YOUTUBE_CLIENT_SECRET and restart Ezra. Ezra only reads your channel and uploads videos as private: you publish them in YouTube Studio.
g_youtubeBorradorAyuda: Uploaded as private with the piece title and, as description, the Instagram text (or the Facebook one). You review and publish it in YouTube Studio.
g_youtubePolitica: YouTube: Ezra never publishes; it uploads as private and you decide in YouTube Studio. If the Google project is not audited, YouTube also keeps videos private.
ez_apps_ninguna: No accounts connected yet. Connect them in Connections.
ez_app_sinLectura: Ezra does not read {red} metrics yet: the connection only prepares and uploads drafts. When reading is added, the real numbers will appear here.
ez_app_contenidoNoDisponible: Not available: Ezra does not read this account's published content yet.
